accounting_rule: Only contract terms, options and draft holds that already existed at this checkpoint are scheduled. Later signings, trades, option decisions, waivers and extensions are not imported. Later salary lists are used only to read the amounts of contract years that already existed.
not_applied: Every transaction, option decision, qualifying offer, waiver and signing dated after 2003-06-26 is excluded; those are simulated events.
